Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.description: At SIDRA Engineering & Construction Company, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal data you share with us. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.
Privacy.section1Desc: When you contact us, request a quote, or use our services, we may collect personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, and details regarding your project inquiry.
Privacy.section2Desc: We use the information collected to:
Privacy.section2List1: Respond to your inquiries and provide accurate quotes.
Privacy.section2List2: Communicate with you regarding ongoing or future projects.
Privacy.section2List3: Improve our services and website experience.
Privacy.section3Desc: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure that your personal data is kept secure and protected against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.
Privacy.section4Desc: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to outside parties except when necessary to fulfill your request (e.g., subcontractors, legally required disclosures).
